effect_policy: This package selects semantic/contract/design preparation only. No native apply, implementation, publication or permission is selected.
iteration_policy: Logical dependency order, not timestamps. Iterate with explicit successors; freeze one coherent cut with all bridge targets resolved before conformant generation.
noncollapse_rules: Every reference binds an explicit identity/revision; evidence pins exact source bytes.
Artifact identity, represented subject, ontology node, source standing and runtime permission remain distinct.
Generated graphs cannot replace authored design or prove their own semantic adequacy.
A required unresolved mapping blocks conformance; recording residue is not a waiver.
Local approval/commit is not canonical repository publication; neither is release or deployment.
Existing native code may be referenced as a realization with provenance, never a fabricated historical chain.
prototype_policy: Exploratory or legacy evidence may expose gaps; it cannot claim conformant generation or bypass required stages.
source_policy: Exact meanings and profiles keep digests and standing. Candidate inclusion grants no admission.
